title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 12804 Chillicothe Road in Chesterland, Ohio, as the "Sgt. Wolfgang Kyle Weninger Post Office Building".
official_summary: This act designates the facility of the U.S. Postal Service located at 12804 Chillicothe Road in Chesterland, Ohio, as the Sgt. Wolfgang Kyle Weninger Post Office Building.

summary.headline: Congress named a post office in Chesterland, Ohio after Sgt. Wolfgang Kyle Weninger.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 12804 Chillicothe Road in Chesterland, Ohio, as the Sgt. Wolfgang Kyle Weninger Post Office Building. It does not change how the post office operates, its services, or its staff. It is an honorary designation.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on November 25, 2024.
